question: What is the aim of the PM WANI Scheme?

options.text: Giving rural people affordable life insurance services
Developing skills among rural youth to repair digital infrastructure
Providing broadband access in all villages by 2022

solution:
The correct answer is __**Proliferation of public Wi-Fi networks**__.

__
 
• **The aim of the PM WANI Scheme is the Proliferation of public Wi-Fi networks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• PM WANI Scheme__

 
 
• **PM WANI** stands for ​**Prime Minister Wi-Fi Access Network Interface.**
 
• **Launched by: **Department of Telecommunications under **Ministry of Communications.**
 
• **Objective: **It envisaged to leverage public Wi-Fi network for the delivery of broadband services.
 
• It was approved by the Union Cabinet in **December 2020.** 
 
• The government aims to provide internet connectivity through **Public Data Offices (PDOs)** as a part of the WANI scheme.
 
• Under this scheme, no license fee will be charged for providing broadband internet services.
 
• The WANI framework contains the following components:
 
 
• Public Data Office (PDO).
 
• Public Data Office Aggregator (PDOA).
 
• App Provider.
 
• Central Registry
